author: /root

findings.detail: The clock starts before argparse, pin reads and launch. Work deadline is absolute STARTED+830 seconds; hard deadline is STARTED+900. The parent does not depend on catchable child exceptions.
At the work cutoff the parent signals the process group with SIGINT, escalates at +10 seconds to SIGTERM and +15 seconds to SIGKILL, and caps reap/drain at min(stop+30, hard-40).
Raw combined child output is bounded at 32 MiB and hashed incrementally. Exclusive reservation, raw output readback, parent receipt and completion are persisted separately from the child application.
Exact parent, child and interpreter pins, private reviewer, root executor, one invocation and no retry are checked. Existing output/work paths refuse another invocation.
signal_child sends a group signal only while the leader is alive. This review admits a child whose separately reviewed sandbox forbids subprocess/fork; it does not claim arbitrary descendant cleanup.

Local read/write/fsync and final readback are synchronous OS calls. Source review supports the finite process-control envelope under responsive local I/O, not an OS-level guarantee against an indefinitely stalled filesystem.

required_actual_control: One source-admitted inert child ignores SIGINT and SIGTERM; unchanged escalation must SIGKILL, reap, and persist/read back parent receipt. No application/native/model/ledger execution.
review_method: Read exact source and its reachable stdlib imports and I/O; AST syntax only, no imports or execution of the subject.
